label: Nothing is the efficient cause of itself, in any respect, from priority
meaning: ST I q.2 a.3, second way: a self-cause would be prior to itself (STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-IS-PRIOR-TO-EFFECT), and nothing is prior to itself (STMT-NOTHING-PRIOR-TO-ITSELF). The Secunda Via result proves this step only internally; recorded here as its own derivation of STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF, which reaches the root (through NO-COMPONENT-FIRST-FROM-POTENCY-OR-PARTICIPATION and the uniting-cause derivation) with no recorded derivation. Priority is the same relation in both premises (priority by nature, DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME). Both premises stay open.
